items.title: Hung jury in trial of man accused of Busselton 'love triangle' murder
items.summary: A jury is discharged in the murder trial of James Anthony Sorgiovanni, 29, who had been accused of the stabbing murder of a woman whose body was found stuffed in a wardrobe.

items.title: How the Microsoft outage is affecting Australians

items.title: Teen sentenced for 'vicious' attack on woman sleeping rough

items.title: 'Embarrassing' state of Indigenous rights must be addressed, UN expert says
